clue.text: Gospel? It's unopened book of the Bible

indicators.note: a thing left unopened has lost its front, so the opening letter goes

parts.note: gospel truth: something said to be gospel is the absolute truth

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a particular book of scripture counts as a Gospel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unopened' takes the first letter T off TRUTH.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth is a short Old Testament book telling the story of Ruth the Moabite.

clue.text: Egyptians having pronounced beautiful round figures

indicators.note: pronounced means said aloud, so the clue's words are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: fair means beautiful; O is a round figure, the shape of zero; two of them are OS

explanation.surface: Egyptians are said to have lovely curvy figures.
explanation.walkthrough: FAIR OS, said aloud, gives the sound of the rulers of ancient Egypt.
explanation.definitionFit: The pharaohs were the kings of ancient Egypt, so they are Egyptians by example.

clue.text: Record former requirement prior to a test

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record
late means former, as in the late chairman

explanation.surface: A record of earlier study is needed before an exam.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a learner driver must show an L-plate, a square plate with a red L, on the car until passing the driving test.
explanation.definitionFit: Learner drivers must display this plate on their vehicle until they pass their driving examination.

clue.text: US general and journalist got together

parts.note: George Marshall was a US general, later Secretary of State
ED is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: An American general and a reporter met up.
explanation.definitionFit: To marshal people or things is to assemble them, gathering them in order.

clue.text: Appearing to have a high temperature with disease building?

definitions.text: Appearing to have a high temperature

parts.note: flu, influenza, is a disease
a shed is a simple building

explanation.surface: Someone looks feverish as an illness builds up in them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'building' reads as a verb about the disease growing, but it is a noun, a shed.
explanation.definitionFit: A flushed face is red and hot, the look of someone running a fever.

clue.text: Kingdom offering enjoyment starts to get irresponsible

parts.note: fun means enjoyment

indicators.note: the starts of the next two words are their opening letters only

explanation.surface: A realm offering pleasure begins to turn reckless.
explanation.walkthrough: Biology classifies living things into kingdoms, and fungi form one of them.
explanation.definitionFit: In biological classification the fungi make up a kingdom of their own, apart from plants and animals.

clue.text: Curse deadline arranged for being free of dangerous weapons

indicators.note: arranged means put in a new order, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A deadline for disarmament is cursed as it is set.
explanation.definitionFit: A denuclearised region has had its atomic arms removed, the most dangerous weapons of all.

clue.text: Contribution to service? Note donations falling short

parts.note: PS, postscript, is a note added to a letter

indicators.note: falling short means coming up one letter short at the end

parts.note: alms are charitable donations

explanation.surface: At a church service, a reminder that the collection is disappointing.
explanation.definitionFit: A psalm is a sacred song sung or said as part of a church service.

clue.text: Seized advantage when morris dancers function, we hear, with extra aspiration

indicators.note: with extra means a further letter is put into the sound
we hear means the words are taken by their sound

parts.note: morris dancers, English folk dancers, traditionally perform on May Day, the first of May
aspiration is the breathed sound of the letter H

explanation.surface: Someone profited when folk dancers performed, with extra breathiness.
explanation.walkthrough: MAY DAY said aloud runs together as 'made-ay'; 'with extra aspiration' adds the H sound inside, giving MADE HAY.
explanation.definitionFit: To make hay while the sun shines is an idiom for exploiting an opportunity fully.

clue.text: Port having no time to provide security

indicators.note: having no means the stretch named next is left out

parts.note: an anchorage is a place where ships moor, a port
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A harbour without a time limit offers safety to ships.
explanation.definitionFit: To anchor something is to hold it fast, making it secure and stable.

clue.text: Swimming in Red Sea close to the edge

indicators.note: swimming suggests letters moving about, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone bathing in the Red Sea stays near the shore.
explanation.walkthrough: The nearside of a road vehicle is the side next to the kerb.
explanation.definitionFit: The nearside is the side of a vehicle nearest the kerb, the road's margin.

clue.text: Timely expression of support given with letter read out

parts.note: right on! is an exclamation of approval

indicators.note: read out means spoken aloud, so the letter's name is heard

parts.note: Q is a letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: A supportive exclamation comes as a letter is read aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done right on cue happens at exactly the right moment, like an actor's prompt.

clue.text: I may adore Mary and hate Gloria perversely

indicators.note: perversely means in a contrary, twisted way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A person who worships the Virgin perversely hates the Gloria.
explanation.walkthrough: The Gloria is a hymn of praise in the Mass, which makes hating it perverse for a devout person.
explanation.definitionFit: A hagiolater worships saints, and the Virgin Mary is the chief saint venerated.

clue.text: Like Cinders, initially awkward and reticent?

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so only the opening letter is used

parts.note: shy means reticent

explanation.surface: Cinderella is described as clumsy and bashful at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cinders' looks like Cinderella's nickname, but here it means actual cinders.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinders are burnt remains, grey and powdery like ash.

clue.text: US soldiers invading in a significant way, showing great authority

indicators.note: invading means pushing in, so these letters go inside the others

parts.note: materially means significantly
GIs are American soldiers

explanation.surface: American troops invade on a large scale and assert command.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting magisterially means acting with the commanding air of a magistrate or master.

clue.text: Fellow entertaining English is French and least likely to be generous

indicators.note: entertaining means holding as a guest, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a fellow is a man
est is French for is

explanation.surface: A man hosting an Englishman is French and tight-fisted.
explanation.definitionFit: The meanest person is the stingiest, the one least willing to give.

clue.text: I leap around church, stuck in a freezing place

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the church goes inside

parts.note: a bound is a leap
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone jumps about a church, caught in a cold spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship that is icebound is trapped by frozen sea.

clue.text: Bluff Henry has ring — but surely not this one!

definitions.text: Bluff Henry has ring — but surely not this one!

parts.note: Henry VIII was nicknamed Bluff King Hal
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: Henry VIII, the hearty king, wears a ring, though hardly a saintly one.
explanation.walkthrough: A halo is the ring round a saint's head, and the much-married Henry VIII was no saint.
explanation.definitionFit: A halo is the circle of light painted round a saint's head, one ring a womanising king never earned.

clue.text: Warning that is left before final scene

indicators.note: before means the first piece comes ahead of the second

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
the ending is the final scene

explanation.surface: A warning is given that someone departed before the last act.
explanation.definitionFit: Portending means foreshadowing something ominous, so it gives warning of it.

clue.text: Amenable and upright character engaged by factory

indicators.note: engaged by means held within, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: a plant is a factory
I is a letter that stands upright, a single vertical stroke

explanation.surface: An agreeable, honest person is hired by a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: A pliant person is easily persuaded, flexible and compliant.

clue.text: Natural place known for its water springing up

indicators.note: springing up in a down clue means read from bottom to top

parts.note: Evian is a French town famous for its bottled mineral water

explanation.surface: A natural spring of famous water bubbles up.
explanation.definitionFit: A naive person is unaffected and artless, acting in a natural way.

clue.text: Squalid place with old heretic making a bit of money

parts.note: a den is a squalid haunt
Arius was a 4th-century priest whose teaching was condemned as heresy

explanation.surface: A seedy dive and an ancient heretic together turn a small profit.
explanation.definitionFit: The denarius was a silver coin of ancient Rome, a small piece of currency.

clue.text: Plant that's yellow getting pulled up

parts.note: or is the heraldic name for gold or yellow
chid is an old past tense of chide, to pull someone up for a fault

explanation.surface: A yellow flower is uprooted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pulled up' suggests uprooting, but it means told off.
explanation.definitionFit: The orchid is a flowering plant with many species.

clue.text: Pal lacking a prominent feature

indicators.note: lacking means without, so the letter named next is dropped

parts.note: china is rhyming slang for mate: china plate, mate

explanation.surface: A friend is short of a notable characteristic.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney rhyming slang, china (from china plate) means mate, a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: The chin is a facial feature that sticks out, sometimes conspicuously.

clue.text: Feature of vehicle's alignment that is coming back into fashion

indicators.note: coming back into means the turned letters go inside the word for fashion, entering it

parts.note: ton is an old word for fashion, as in bon ton

indicators.note: coming back means returning, so these letters are read in reverse

parts.note: IE is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A car's wheel alignment is becoming fashionable again.
explanation.definitionFit: Toe-in is a setting where the front wheels angle slightly inward, part of a car's tracking.

clue.text: Hard stuff, metal — need somehow to clamp it

indicators.note: clamp it means grip the metal, holding it inside
somehow means in some way or other, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: tin is a metal

explanation.surface: A dentist's instruction about metal fillings: rework the need to clamp it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dentine is the hard calcified tissue forming the bulk of a tooth beneath the enamel.
